query:
SELECT o.id, o.slug
        FROM organizations o
        WHERE ($2
               OR o.id IN (SELECT organization_id FROM organization_admins WHERE user_id = $1)
               OR o.id IN (
                   SELECT l.organization_id
                   FROM organization_teams l
                   JOIN team_members m ON m.team_id = l.team_id
                   WHERE m.user_id = $1
               ))
          -- Not `$3 IS NULL OR ...`: a generic plan could not seek the
          -- slug index. Slugs are never empty (a CHECK constraint).
          AND o.slug > COALESCE($3::text, '')
        ORDER BY o.slug
        LIMIT $4
